title: ChatVibeAskRequest
description: chat.vibe-ask-request@1: a first-party service asks Vibe, OpenVibe's assistant, on a person's behalf (Vibe by voice: OpenVibe.Bot passes what the person said after their machine's call word). Chat keeps it in the person's own Vibe chats, one chat per source ("Voice on <machine>"), and answers with Vibe's reply, which counts against the person's daily allowance like any of their Vibe answers. POST /internal/chat/vibe/ask, capability chat.vibe.ask, loopback only.

subject.description: The person Vibe answers, as the calling service vouches (Bot: the machine's owner, with voice on for that machine).

id.description: The source's stable id (the machine's device id): one chat per source.

name.description: What to call it in the chat's name (the machine's name).

idempotency_key.description: The caller's id for this ask (Bot: device id and the voice_ask id): asked again, the same answer, once.
